Strategy: Prefer a bin that, after placement, leaves a residual within five units of the current tightest residual, creating a twin of the tightest bin for future matching. It may help by duplicating useful residual sizes, but may fail if the tightest residual is itself a poor size to copy.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (50 if abs(r - item - min(bins)) <= 5 else 0) for r in bins]
```
